routes.name: Universal Classifier
routes.description: Classifies ALL events (Docker, Edge, Journal, Syslog) via universal_classifier pipeline. Sets classification field. Non-final: events continue to routing below.

routes.name: SIEM to Splunk
routes.description: Routes security-classified events to Splunk HEC for SIEM analysis (10.10.0.66:8088)

routes.name: Ops to S3
routes.description: Routes operational events to MinIO S3 for long-term archival. Non-final: continues to ES.

routes.name: Ops to Elasticsearch
routes.description: Routes operational events to Elasticsearch for Kibana dashboards

routes.name: Default Catch-All
routes.description: Safety net: any unrouted events go to Splunk HEC for investigation
